title: join
description: C→S. A boat takes a course. `revision` is what the boat already holds. `race` and `division` are named where the sailor named them — which is the only thing that can settle which division a boat is in once two of them sail one course; without them the server finds the race from the course and the day (§8.2).

lengthM.description: How long the boat is, in metres. The boat's own screens draw the hull to scale and zoom no closer than a few of these; the server carries it onto the record.

allocatedStart.description: This boat's own start time, for a race with an allocated start — asked when it joins.
